stem.text: The graph shows the boiling points of the hydrogen compounds of Group 16 elements.

stem.alt: Line graph of boiling point /°C (axis ticks 100, 0, −100) against Group 16 hydrogen compounds: H2O point at 100 °C; H2S point below 0 °C near −60 °C; H2Se and H2Te points rising in turn above H2S.

stem.text: Which statement correctly explains why water does **not** fit the trend of the other compounds?

A.text: There are fewer electrons in the oxygen atoms so there is less shielding of the nuclear charge.

B.text: There are strong hydrogen bonds in water but **not** in the other compounds.

C.text: The covalent bonds in water are much stronger than in the other compounds.

D.text: The water molecules are smaller and so have stronger van der Waals' forces.
